title: Mass-stationarity of diffuse random measures via allocations
exact_target: For diffuse mass on a general locally compact Abelian group, do all preserving allocation shifts characterize a typical location in the mass?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900008 (AMR-098-0008). CC BY 4.0.

Hermann Thorisson, \emph{Some Open Probability Problems}, author preprint; original Universidad de Buenos Aires copy preserved in Internet Archive capture of 27 March 2024, Section 4, mass-stationarity definition and Theorem 4.2, p. 5; Problem 4.1, p. 6.
